top_signals.title: Premier League: US owners dominate over half of 20 clubs

top_signals.title: London’s nexus of power is finally being challenged
top_signals.summary: London is so dominant as a global city that any recalibration is unlikely to hurt. Its real competitors are New York and Dubai — not Manchester.
